subject: Private Offer: regional SLA credit + rev-share sync (EU/APAC carveouts)
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-05-11 09:12 PDT
Subject: EdgeWave private offer - regional SLA credit + rev-share ask

Karthik / Marissa — quick sync. EdgeWave (prospect -> pilot -> potential $1.4M ARR) has come back with a request to ship a Private Offer on AWS and GCP with three non-standard items: an upfront credit, a reduced rev-share in EU regions, and an SLA credit clause tied to regional availability (they operate tightly across EU and APAC). Samir at CloudBroker (their marketplace integration partner) flagged the rev-share carveouts as a blocker for publishing.

Attached: EdgeWave_PrivateOffer_v1.pdf (private offer draft), SLA_Credit_Worksheet.xlsx (requested credit examples), Marketplace_RevShare_Summary.csv (current standard splits).

Ask: can we (1) confirm what level of rev-share deviation we can approve without exec signoff, (2) whether we can offer a one-time $75k upfront credit against first invoice, and (3) if SLA credit language up to 5% MRC per major outage window is acceptable or needs legal/exec review?

I recommend looping Jonas for marketplace-side alignment if we need to deviate from the 20% baseline on AWS. Markus, can you give a quick headcount on finance impact (revenue recognition + commission)?

Thanks — this came in from Alex Chen (cc'ed on thread from their procurement team). I want to bundle a single ask for Marissa to present to the deal desk/executive sponsor if needed.

—Olga
Olga Petrov
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-05-11 11:03 PDT
Subject: Re: EdgeWave private offer - regional SLA credit + rev-share ask

Thanks Olga. I reviewed the attachments. Quick notes: 

- Rev-share: AWS marketplace standard to ISVs/partners is 20% (our current internal policy). We can provisionally allow a temporary carveout to 12-15% for strategic pilots but anything below 12% needs finance + deal desk escalation. For GCP we have more flexibility but the listing flows differ.
- Upfront credit: $75k is material; finance needs to see the amortization plan (credit applied against first 90 days of invoices).
- SLA credit: the worksheet looks reasonable; legal will need to confirm the exact phrasing for indemnities. 5% MRC cap per major outage seems within precedent.

I agree with looping Jonas for the marketplace publishing call — Samir can help with the listing timing. Marissa, if you can consolidate these three asks into a one-pager (short bullets + P&L impact), I will support escalation to execs.

-Karthik
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Samir Rao <samir@cloudbroker.io>
Date: 2028-05-11 12:28 PDT
Subject: Re: EdgeWave private offer - regional SLA credit + rev-share ask

Looping in marketplace operations context. Two important operational constraints for publishing Private Offers across clouds: 

1) AWS Marketplace (Private Offers) enforces platform fees that flow through our rev-share calculation; any external carveout in EU requires an approval path since EU region listings may still remit via global settlement.
2) Publishing timeline: if we accept the $75k credit and net30 payment, we can list in 6-8 business days provided legal signoff happens same-day. Otherwise listing slips by ~2 weeks.

Samir — can you confirm if EdgeWave's marketplace account is configured for EU tag/wiring (they previously confirmed region split but I want it in writing)?

Operational ask: If we take this to execs, please highlight the publishing slip risk (we may miss their June go-live). I can prepare a one-slide ops impact note.

Jonas
From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@edgewave.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@edgewave.com>
Date: 2028-05-12 08:07 PDT
Subject: Re: EdgeWave private offer - regional SLA credit + rev-share ask

Thanks team — appreciate the quick turnaround. We are prepared to proceed subject to a few clarifications: 

- Upfront credit: $75,000 applied against the first invoice is acceptable.
- Rev-share: we are asking for a temporary reduction to 12% for EU regions for the first 6 months while we validate latency-sensitive usage. After 6 months we revert to standard split or renegotiate based on usage tiers.
- Payment terms: Net30 is required for procurement approval.
- SLA language: the proposed 5% MRC credit per major regional outage is acceptable, but procurement needs an example clause to show to legal.

We understand there may be a publishing timeline and are happy to coordinate with Samir to ensure their marketplace configuration is correct. We need a decision within 72 hours to hit our June launch window.

Regards,
Alex Chen
Head of Cloud Ops
EdgeWave
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-05-12 10:55 PDT
Subject: Re: EdgeWave private offer - regional SLA credit + rev-share ask

I've drafted the one-pager and attached a short P&L impact table (see Marketplace_RevShare_Summary.csv). Summary for exec ask: 

1) Approve temporary EU rev-share carveout to 12% for 6 months (reason: latency-sensitive pilot; estimated ARR dilution ~$42k over 6 months).
2) Approve one-time upfront credit of $75k applied to first invoice and amortized over Q1 revenue recognition.
3) Approve Net30 payment terms for EdgeWave (they are strategic pilot customer).
4) Approve SLA credit language up to 5% MRC per major outage window (Legal to finalize language).

If approved by execs, Jonas and Samir can coordinate listing; Markus, please confirm commission and revenue booking impacts so we can include them in the exec memo.

-Marissa
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-05-13 16:48 PDT
Subject: Executive escalation: EdgeWave private offer approvals needed (recap & asks)

Team — thanks for the fast work. This thread is the packet for Marissa to take to Deal Desk / Exec. Recap and asks below (short):

Recap: EdgeWave requests a Private Offer on AWS + GCP for EU/APAC regions. They asked for a $75k upfront credit, Net30 payment, temporary EU rev-share carveout to 12% for 6 months, and SLA credit language (5% MRC cap). Timeline: they requested decision within 72 hours to keep June go-live.

Asks for Exec approval (please present as single yes/no per bullet):
- Approve temporary EU rev-share carveout to 12% for 6 months (deal impact: estimated revenue dilution ~$42k; downstream commission adjustment required).
- Approve one-time $75,000 upfront credit to be applied against first invoice (finance: amortize over first 90 days).
- Approve Net30 payment terms for this customer (ops risk: cash timing; suggested mitigation: require PO upfront).
- Approve SLA credit clause up to 5% MRC per major regional outage window (legal to sign off final language).

Attachments for exec packet: EdgeWave_PrivateOffer_v1.pdf, SLA_Credit_Worksheet.xlsx, Marketplace_RevShare_Summary.csv, one-pager (Marissa). Related HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/7821.

Marissa — please escalate to Sarah (COO) and finance execs; include Markus' note on recognition/commission. If execs approve, Jonas + Samir will start the listing workflow immediately to meet June window.

I'll send a short calendar invite for a 20-minute decision slot if you want to review live.

—Olga
